stem.text: Two loudspeakers are connected to the same signal generator. The signal generator produces a single frequency. The loudspeakers face each other so that a stationary sound wave is set up in the region between the loudspeakers.

stem.alt: Two loudspeakers facing each other, and a microphone connected by a cable to a CRO. Labels: microphone; loudspeaker; to CRO.

stem.text: A microphone is connected to a cathode-ray oscilloscope (CRO) and positioned between the two loudspeakers.
The microphone is moved along a line joining the two loudspeakers.

The signal on the CRO shows 5 maximum amplitudes as the microphone moves. The microphone moves a distance of $2.0\,\text{m}$ from the position that gives the first maximum to the position that gives the fifth maximum.
What is the wavelength of the sound wave?
